description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller class named CustomerOptionsController, responsible for managing customer options within an admin panel. It provides endpoints for listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting customer options, including handling associated descriptions and validation.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing customer options in the admin interface, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and listing.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of customer options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to show the edit page for a specific customer option by ID.

methods.name: displayOptionCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to show the creation page for a new customer option.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Private method to prepare and display the customer option form for creation or editing, populating descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to validate, save or update a customer option, including descriptions and validation errors.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to paginated list of customer options, returning JSON data.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a customer option by ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private method to set menu related attributes in the model for UI navigation.
